crossRefs.note: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah.…
“Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.
He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day…

people.name: Kish
people.line: Father of Saul, the first king of Israel

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: The donkeys of Kish, Saul’s father, were lost. Kish said to Saul his son, “Now take one of the servants with you, and arise, go look for the donkeys.”
translations.bsb: One day the donkeys of Saul’s father Kish wandered off, and Kish said to his son Saul, “Take one of the servants and go look for the donkeys.”
translations.kjv: And the asses of Kish Saul's father were lost. And Kish said to Saul his son, Take now one of the servants with thee, and arise, go seek the asses.
translations.asv: And the asses of Kish, Saul's father, were lost. And Kish said to Saul his son, Take now one of the servants with thee, and arise, go seek the asses.
